title: ResourceSearchResponse must be decoded according to its ResultFormat, not assumed to be a ResourceTable
answers: How do I read rows out of a ResourceSearchResponse?
Why do old ResourceTable-based decoders break on FIELD_VALUES responses?
How to add a new hybrid search lookup that reads string fields from search results?
body:
Symptom: code that reads resp.Results.Columns/Rows directly breaks or silently returns empty data when the server answers with the FIELD_VALUES format instead of RESOURCE_TABLE.
Root cause: ResourceSearchResponse can be shaped as either a ResourceTable (resp.Results, byte cells) or FIELD_VALUES (resp.Fields + resp.Rows[].Values, typed ResourceSearchValue).
Fix pattern: lexicalHitsFromResponse (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_hybrid.go) switches on resp.GetResultFormat(): UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE goes through lexicalHitsFromTable, FIELD_VALUES goes through lexicalHitsFromFieldValues which calls DecodeSearchValues per row and extracts scalars via searchStringValue (errors if a field decodes to non-string or a multi-value scalar). Any new result field read from a hybrid search response must follow this same dual-format decode, and requests that want the lighter format must set ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES explicitly (default is RESOURCE_TABLE).
Constraints: only applies to code consuming resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse from the search backends; unrelated to the external vector search path.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_hybrid.go decoding of ResourceSearchResponse (lexical, managed-by, folder-title lookups)
says: Search results show no rows even when database contains matching records
Decoding breaks when search response format changes between types
Hybrid search returns data but fields are unreadable
Different result formats cause silent failures extracting search results
How to extract typed field values from search response correctly
search: ResourceSearchResponse decoding must match result format: RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED stores rows in Results.Rows with typed Cells, while FIELD_VALUES stores rows directly in Rows with typed ResourceSearchValue fields. Code reading only Results.Columns/Rows breaks against FIELD_VALUES responses. Pattern: pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_hybrid.go:lexicalHitsFromResponse switches on GetResultFormat() to route to lexicalHitsFromTable or lexicalHitsFromFieldValues (which calls DecodeSearchValues and validates scalar types via searchStringValue). Set ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES explicitly to request the lighter format.
